caption: The drawing depicts a single chair positioned against a plain, light beige background. The chair has a padded seat and backrest, both upholstered in a textured red fabric with intricate floral or leafy patterns in varying shades of red and hints of purple. The backrest is rounded at the top with a slight curve and indented sides. The seat is rectangular and cushioned. The chair has four straight wooden legs, each brown in color with fine lines indicating grain, and features carved decorative elements at the tops of the front legs where they meet the seat. There are no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Side Chair
